name: alreadyAtEOFReturnsNull
input: TarArchiveInputStream initialized with an empty stream or after reaching EOF (hasHitEOF = true)
expected: Returns null immediately because hasHitEOF is true, as specified in the Javadoc.

name: readsFirstStandardEntrySuccessfully
input: A tar archive containing a single standard valid file entry
expected: Returns the TarArchiveEntry corresponding to the first header, sets entryOffset to 0 and entrySize correctly.

name: skipsUnreadDataOfCurrentEntryBeforeMovingToNext
input: A tar archive with two entries where the first entry has not been fully read (entryOffset < entrySize)
expected: Automatically skips over remaining bytes of the current entry using skip(), then successfully returns the second entry.

name: throwsRuntimeExceptionWhenSkipFails
input: Current entry has unread bytes, but skip() returns 0 or negative due to unexpected end of stream
expected: Throws a RuntimeException with message 'failed to skip current tar entry' because unread data cannot be bypassed.

name: throwsIOExceptionOnInvalidHeaderBytes
input: A tar archive containing malformed header bytes that cause TarArchiveEntry constructor to throw IllegalArgumentException
expected: Catches IllegalArgumentException and throws an IOException wrapping it with message 'Error detected parsing the header'.

name: handlesGNULongNameEntryFollowedByRegularEntry
input: A tar archive starting with a GNU long name entry header, followed by the actual data name payload and the real file entry
expected: Reads the long name payload, trims any trailing null terminator, applies it to the next entry via recursion (getNextEntry()), and returns the correctly named entry.

name: handlesGNULongNameEntryFollowedByEOF
input: A tar archive containing a GNU long name entry header, but no subsequent entry follows (hits EOF during name read)
expected: Returns null after recursively calling getNextEntry() and finding currEntry to be null (Bugzilla 40334 fix).

name: processesPaxHeaderEntry
input: A tar archive containing a POSIX/PAX extended header entry followed by the target file entry
expected: Parses the PAX headers using parsePaxHeaders/paxHeaders(), applies them to the subsequent entry, and returns the updated entry.

name: processesGNUSparseEntryWithoutExtension
input: A tar archive containing a GNU sparse entry header where isExtended() is false
expected: Recognizes it as a sparse entry via isGNULongNameEntry/isGNUSparse, invokes readGNUSparse(), and returns the entry with updated entrySize.

name: processesGNUSparseEntryWithExtendedHeader
input: A tar archive containing a GNU sparse entry where isExtended() is true, followed by additional sparse header records
expected: Loops through getRecord() to read all extended sparse records until isExtended() is false, then returns the target entry.

name: returnsNullWhenEndOftarArchiveReachedDuringRecordRead
input: A tar archive where all entries have been read and the next record read returns null or EOF record
expected: Sets hasHitEOF to true and returns null, indicating the end of the archive.
